definitions.short: properly, rubbed ; but used abstractly, a rubbing (with perfumery)
definitions.full: H4795. maruq [ מָרוּק ] (Kö ii. 138 ) noun [masculine] a scraping, rubbing ; — only plural suffix מְרוּקֵיהֶן יְמֵי Est 2:12 literally the days of their (bodily) rubbings , i.e. the year's preparation of girls for the harem.
